subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap: Redwood vs CompetitorX

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>

Subject: Competitive bake-off recap: Redwood vs CompetitorX

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation. Quick recap and the recommended next steps so we’re aligned.

Key pain points you called out:
- Latency spikes on peak traffic (p50 < 120ms ok, p95 spikes impacting UX)
- Unit inference cost and predictability for high-throughput batch jobs
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 evidence, audit logs, ability to run in a VPC/private deployment
- Model quality drift on finance/legal prompt sets — need repeatable evals

Goals for the bake-off:
1) Verify steady-state latency and p95 under realistic QPS for 512-token responses
2) Compare cost-per-1k-tokens at expected throughput patterns
3) Validate integration points (SSO, API integration, audit logs) and private deployment options
4) Run accuracy/quality checks across your core prompt sets (KPI: >= baseline pass rate)

Decision criteria we’ll use:
- Latency (p50/p95) and tail behavior
- Cost (per-token) at both burst and sustained rates
- Security controls (KMS, audit logs, private VPC)
- Operational features: canary rollouts, fallback routing, autoscaling behavior

Open questions / asks for Acme:
- Can you share an anonymized sample of typical queries (we only need text and metadata, no PII) — public S3 or secure transfer works
- Target throughput profile (qps + burst) so we can reproduce load
- Any non-negotiable compliance requirements beyond SOC 2?

Recommended tests (we attached a short test plan):
- Latency/throughput benchmark (512 tokens, 5 minute steady window + 1min burst)
- Quality eval on 3 prompt sets (finance, legal, customer-support)
- Failover/routing test comparing Redwood vs CompetitorX for degraded capacity

Attachments: redwood-bakeoff-test-plan.pdf (test cases, metrics we’ll capture)

Next steps / owners:
- Marissa (Redwood) — run build of test harness and share results by Aug 9
- Acme — provide anonymized sample by Aug 6
- Legal — finalize NDA/PO if needed (Jordan to confirm)
- Schedule follow-up demo & results review: proposed Aug 10 at 2pm PT

If that looks right I’ll lock in Aug 10 2pm PT and get the harness running.

—
